basics.name: Hilal Ahmad Najar
basics.title: Cloud Data Engineer
basics.summary: Results-driven Data Engineer with 5 years of experience building scalable ELT/ETL pipelines across GCP and Snowflake. Proficient in leveraging modern data stack technologies including dbt, Kubernetes, BigQuery, Composer (Airflow), Cloud SQL, and Pub/Sub. Proven track record of architecting robust data models (including Iceberg and CDC tracking), automating multi-environment schemas, and delivering high-impact solutions through effective cross-functional collaboration.

bullets: Built production dbt + Snowflake (Iceberg) ELT pipeline for merchant underwriting data, implementing 100+ incremental models with CDC-based history tracking, enforced data contracts, and multi-environment schema automation across dev/QA/cert/prod
Migrated Tokenization application from Appengine to Kubernetes Engine increasing Performance 50% and optimizing cost and resource utilization
Optimized BigQuery performance through partitioning and clustering—reduced query costs by 25%.
Built automated auditing frameworks in Cloud Composer for real-time data validation—boosted data quality by 40%.
Collaborated cross-functionally to integrate pipelines, ensuring 99.9% uptime and seamless data delivery.
Designed CDC pipelines with Striim for BigQuery, ingesting 2 TB/day within 5-minute SLAs.
Enhanced SQL and Dataflow job performance—cut execution times by 35% and compute costs by 20%.
Automated DAG dependency management in Composer—achieved 95% on-time job accuracy.
Mentored junior developers on GCP best practices and ETL design patterns.
Developed batch ETL processes in GCP using Python and Unix shell—handled nightly loads of 500M+ records.
Scheduled and monitored Dataflow jobs through Composer—ensured 24/7 pipeline reliability.
Implemented BigQuery transformations with schema evolution and consistency checks.
